theorems.name: Submission.cbrld_cone_eval_eq_of_eqOn_open
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U G : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (φ₁ φ₂ : TestFormOn U k), IsOpen G → X.support ⊆ G → EqOn (φ₁ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) (φ₂ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) G → X φ₁ = X φ₂
